root_motivation: No tool on this laptop can distinguish the three valid states of a process's agent-namespace surface (/proc/<pid>/agent_session): kernel absent, kernel present but process unwrapped (healthy/expected), or kernel present and process wrapped (live session). This missing discriminator causes ~20 consecutive false-alarm flags in /self-review and leaves the kernel's per-namespace syscall counter surface completely unread by any tool.
user_persona: Claude (or jsy) running /self-review on a wintermute kernel laptop; needs a read-only CLI that returns a machine-readable tri-state verdict so downstream scripts can branch correctly without manual interpretation.

acceptance_criteria.description: agentns-doctor status --format json on this init-ns session emits {"state":"init","session_nonzero":false,"verdict":"unwrapped-expected"} with a non-null integer ns_inode and exit code 0.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac1.rs: run binary with --format json, parse output, assert state==init, session_nonzero==false, verdict==unwrapped-expected, ns_inode is non-null integer

acceptance_criteria.description: With a --proc-root fixture dir where agent_session is absent, status returns state:absent, verdict:kernel-absent, exit 0. With --expect-kernel flag, exit 2.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac2.rs: create tmp dir without agent_session, run status --proc-root <tmp>, assert state==absent, exit==0; run again with --expect-kernel, assert exit==2

acceptance_criteria.description: With --proc-root fixture dir where agent_session contains a non-zero 32-hex string, status returns state:live, session_nonzero:true, verdict:wrapped, and echoes the 32-hex id.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac3.rs: write fixture agent_session with non-zero 32-hex, run status --proc-root <tmp> --format json, assert state==live, session_nonzero==true, verdict==wrapped, session_id matches fixture

acceptance_criteria.description: With --proc-root fixture dir where agent_session contains a non-hex or wrong-length value, status returns state:malformed, exit 3.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac4.rs: write fixture with 16-char garbage value, assert state==malformed, exit==3

acceptance_criteria.description: agentns-doctor counters --format json reproduces the seven kernel counter fields (total_syscalls, openat_count, write_bytes, connect_count, unlink_count, fork_count, elapsed_ns); on init ns all are 0 and a note field is present.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac5.rs: run counters --format json on self, parse JSON, assert all 7 keys present, all values == 0, note field present

acceptance_criteria.description: agentns-doctor counters --delta 50 samples twice and produces a delta object with the same 7 keys; on idle init ns every delta is 0.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac6.rs: run counters --delta 50 --format json, assert delta object present with 7 keys all == 0

acceptance_criteria.description: agentns-doctor explain on init ns output contains substrings 'initial agent namespace', 'not a fault', and 'agentns-claude'.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac7.rs: run explain, assert stdout contains all three substrings

acceptance_criteria.description: agentns-doctor --help lists subcommands status, counters, explain; --version prints 0.1.0.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac8.rs: run --help, assert stdout contains 'status', 'counters', 'explain'; run --version, assert '0.1.0'

acceptance_criteria.description: The status --format json object keys are exactly {state, session_id, session_nonzero, ns_inode, intent_tag, pid, verdict} (golden-file key-set test).
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac9.rs: run status --format json on self, parse, assert sorted key set equals golden set exactly

acceptance_criteria.description: No write(2) to any /proc/*/agent_* path under strace/ctrace; no unshare syscall; no kill/signal in unit-level assertion.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac10.rs: unit test classifier functions directly, assert they only open/read paths under proc_root, never write; integration: check binary only opens /proc and does not call unshare

acceptance_criteria.description: agentns-doctor explain on a live fixture (non-zero session) reports the session id and is not the init-ns message.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac11.rs: run explain with --proc-root live fixture, assert output does NOT contain 'not a fault' and DOES contain the hex id

scope: Classify process into one of: absent, init, live, malformed
Emit text and JSON output for status subcommand
Emit counters with optional two-sample delta for counters subcommand
Emit human-readable explanation paragraph for explain subcommand
Support --proc-root <dir> test hook to redirect /proc reads to fixtures
Support --expect-kernel flag to change exit code when kernel surface is absent
non_goals: Does not write to any /proc path; read-only always
Does not unshare, set intent_tag, set budgets, or call prctl
Does not restart, signal, or kill any process
Does not check memlog, provfs, or any kernel surface other than agent_session/agent_counters/ns/agent
Does not perform live wrapped-session smoke test (wrap-gated; requires agentns-claude round-trip)
Does not classify by ns inode value alone; classification is by session value semantics

additional.no_async: true — single-threaded read-only /proc reader; no tokio or async-std
additional.no_network: true — reads only /proc; no network deps

five_whys_trace.q: Why does /self-review keep flagging agentns as broken?
five_whys_trace.a: It only knows two states: file missing (broken) vs file present. All-zeros is treated as broken even though it means 'kernel present, process unwrapped' which is healthy.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does the two-state check cause so much churn?
five_whys_trace.a: Every self-review run for ~20 sessions flags it as 'lone broken kernel asset,' causing wasted cycles and proposed fixes (edit the hook to unshare) that are structurally impossible.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can't we just fix the self-review skill check directly?
five_whys_trace.a: We can (PRD-agentns-doctor-self-review.md), but the fix needs to call something that computes the tri-state — no such tool exists yet, so the skill check can't be fixed without building the discriminator first.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does this need to be a compiled binary rather than a shell function?
five_whys_trace.a: The counters reader needs two-sample delta mode, JSON schema stability is required for downstream parsing, and the --proc-root test hook for fixture-based testing is much cleaner in a compiled binary than in shell.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Should absent exit 0 by default or 2?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Exit 0 by default (stock kernels are not a fault). Exit 2 only with --expect-kernel flag.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is the exact set of JSON keys for status --format json?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Exactly: state, session_id, session_nonzero, ns_inode, intent_tag, pid, verdict. No extras. AC9 pins this as a golden-key-set test.

ambiguities_resolved.question: How should the live AC3 form be handled (requires actual wrap)?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: AC3 live form (agentns-claude ... -- agentns-doctor status returning state:live) is deferred/wrap-gated. AC3 as written covers the fixture-based form which is today-testable and sufficient for archive.
